editorial.blurb: Opart Thai House is a beloved West Town spot where authentic flavors and generous portions make for memorable meals, especially when you venture beyond the classics.
editorial.insiderTip: Order off the beaten path—skip the pad Thai and go for standouts like Nam Tok (beef with toasted rice powder and lime) or Larb Gai; their spice scale goes 1–7, so ask for level 6 if you want proper Thai heat that clears the sinuses.
